captions.detailed: A compact, black pancake lens featuring a shallow cylindrical barrel with a dark glass front element. It has two distinct rings: a wider, ribbed focus ring near the front and a narrower, ribbed manual aperture ring near the rear. Both the focus ring and the aperture ring are designed to rotate continuously and coaxially around the central optical axis of the lens barrel.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact pancake lens model in CadQuery. The lens should feature a main barrel with a front glass element, a wide ribbed focus ring near the front, and a narrower ribbed aperture ring near the rear, with both rings configured for continuous coaxial rotation.
captions.factory: Create three distinct parts: a main barrel, a focus ring, and an aperture ring. Construct the main barrel from cylinders, subtracting a central bore to house a recessed glass cylinder. Model the focus ring and aperture ring as concentric hollowed cylinders, adding fine external ribbing by patterning small triangular cuts or ridges around their outer circumferences. Assemble the parts along the Z-axis, and define continuous rotational joints for both the focus and aperture rings relative to the main barrel.
